items.title: TJX Needs Holiday Cheer to Lift Shares Out of Slump
items.summary: A summer slowdown sank TJX stock, raising concerns that rivals like Ross Stores are taking its business. But Christmas is coming.

items.title: Will TJX (TJX) Beat Estimates Again in Its Next Earnings Report?
items.summary: TJX (TJX) has an impressive earnings surprise history and currently possesses the right combination of the two key ingredients for a likely beat in its next quarterly report.

items.title: Which retail stocks are best positioned ahead of earnings this week?
items.summary: Investing.com -- Six retailers still report this week, per the earnings calendar: Lowe’s (LOW), TJX (TJX) and Target (TGT) on Nov 18 pre-market, then Walmart (WMT) pre-market and PDD Holdings (PDD) on Nov 19. Ross Stores (ROST) reports after the close on Nov 19. Home Depot (HD) already reported this morning, so it is excluded. The calendar was filtered to high- and medium-importance names, so smaller retailers may be missing.

items.title: State Street Consumer Discretionary (XLY) Buys $17.8 Million More Amazon on Nov. 13
items.summary: The fund added $78.0 million across all 47 of its positions, with Amazon and Tesla leading the purchases.

items.title: TJ Maxx, Marshalls Kept Tariff Refunds for Executive Bonuses
items.summary: TJX brands were among a handful of companies named in a report for disclosing their intent to give bonuses to leadership instead of reimbursing shoppers that paid higher prices for tariff-impacted products.

items.title: Earnings to watch: NVIDIA, Walmart, Home Depot and more report this week
items.summary: Investing.com -- This week’s calendar pairs the consumer (Home Depot, Lowe’s, Target, TJX, Walmart) with the AI trade (NVIDIA). Data is from the earnings calendar as of Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 3:17 PM EST. Estimates are consensus and can shift.

items.title: Nvidia Fallout, Anthropic IPO and Other Can't Miss Items this Week
items.summary: Nvidia reports Tuesday, its first earnings since Jensen Huang resigned as CEO. Anthropic is targeting Thursday for its Nasdaq debut. Together, the two events will test the AI trade that has looked shaky in recent weeks.
